newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares firm 0.47 pct to fresh record.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares firm 0.47 pct to fresh record.

text.p: Istanbul shares firmed slightly in continued selective activity on Wednesday, but dropped from earlier highs on profit-taking, brokers said.

The IMKB-100 closed at a new all-time high of 88,748.99, up 413.97 points, or 0.47 percent from Tuesday's previous high of 88,335.02. The index which gained 2.03 percent so far this week, was below an opening high of 89,592.
Trade volume was weaker at 17.93 trillion lira ($177.4 million) after 18.75 trillion ($185.6 million) on Tuesday.

"There is short-term activity in shares which influence the index because it is important to keep the index at above the 87,500 mark," said Serkan Anil from Gedik securities. "I expect a new buying wave, buying may strengthen later in the week."
The index had surged 5.38 percent last week when it pierced major resistance at 85,000 at its fourth attemt since late October and targeted 90,000.
